{{Quote|This was my first exposure to the food service industry, and I picked up plenty of good recipes in the process, mainly because I was being paid in food. One of the best was this yummy sandwich, made with thin slices of tender shaak, melted Byss cheese and topato. Served on toasted or therm-zapped pseudograin bread.|Dex's Diner menu, on the shaak and cheese sandwich|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''shaak and cheese sandwich''' consisted of tender slices of [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]] meat, melted [[Byss cheese]] and [[Topato/Legends|topato]], served on toasted or thermo-zapped [[pseudograin bread]]. The [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwiches]] were served at a [[Unidentified Fondor restaurant|restaurant]]<ref name="Menu" /> at somepoint before [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]<ref name="Date">"[[Dining at Dex's]]" states that the [[Unidentified Fondor restaurant|Fondor restaurant]] was [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] first exposure to the food service industry. Since ''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' depicts Jettster running a bar during [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] must have worked at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] before that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> on the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]<ref name="Menu" /> in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]<ref name="Atlast">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] worked as a street tout for [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] and learned several recipes while working there, including the shaak and cheese sandwich. Jettser was also paid in [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and the sandwich was one of his favorites. After Jettster opened his own restaurant, [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] he sold the shaak and cheese sandwich as part of his lunch menu for 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shaak and cheese sandwiches were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
